rationale: All three declared candidates were measured. Variant_2 improves the baseline mean from 10 to 10.75; its per-sample changes are +2, +1, 0, 0, so no sample regresses. Variant_1 fails the allowed degradation of 1 with a drop of 8 on s4. Revised measurements showing insufficient mean gain or degradation greater than 1 would invalidate this acceptance.
